title: array of three materials mixing the tId/image/icon/link/price alias set with icon-only and image-only Kadam entries

source.name: Kadam Feed and RTB contracts, including in-page and clickunder examples
source.notes: All source records are retained in assets/sources.json by reference.sourceIds.

modifications: All ids, domains, prices, timestamps, creative text and URLs independently authored.

Material [0] uses the tId/image/icon/link/price alias set — the owner-ruled 013 baseline shape's own alternate field names (specs/013-single-push-recognition/spec.md), not a named vendor's; it is included here, alongside two Kadam-shaped entries, because it is the array's only element with bare image/icon keys and therefore the one whose preview is drawn (see specNotes).

Material [0]'s icon/image are inline data: URIs (proving full render on the drawn material); materials [1]/[2] use hosted https URLs, which the sealed preview always blocks pre-fetch — those two are not the drawn material, so their image bytes are never exercised by the preview contract in this case.
No OpenRTB or GET-URL request is invented for this response-only scenario: no registered decoder recognizes a Kadam-style feed request query string (push-kadam-icon-notice, known gap DEF-107).
provenance.sanitized: No real visitor or subscriber data. click_url/link values use reserved .test hostnames and are not intended to be fetched; material [0]'s icon/image are self-contained data: URIs with no external network access at all.

pairApplicability.note: Response-only: no registered decoder recognizes the Kadam feed's GET request shape (DEF-107), so only the documented array-of-materials response shape is exercised here.

specNotes: Kadam documents the array-of-materials shape (formats-feeds map §1.1); this case's three elements cover three distinct, spec-valid material shapes at once: the tId/image/icon/link/price alias set, an icon-only material, and an image-only material.

Spec 014 (push creative preview) requires a material missing an optional creative part to render with what it has — the empty state must not appear while at least one creative element (icon, image, title, or description) is present; icon-only and image-only are both explicitly valid per that contract, not partially-broken shapes.
Spec 014 US2 previews only the array's first material; material [0] is the one exercised by expect.preview here, which is why it — not [1] or [2] — carries the data: URI proving full render.

detectFeedFormat unions tags across every array element (format-detect.js), so material [0]'s bare image/icon/link keys are enough to tag the whole array push even though [1]/[2] use the `_url`-suffixed aliases detectFeedFormat does not recognize on their own (see push-x-kadam-material-single, DEF-160, for that alias gap in isolation).
notes: Core observations in the source archive were deliberately excluded from expectations. Protocol metadata may describe a vendor-specific 2.x carrier; it does not claim a normative minor-version inference.

bids.limitation: The icon is a remote https URL; the sealed preview frame allows img-src data: blob: only, so it is refused and the card renders without it. Contract behaviour (012), not a defect.
The hero image is a remote https URL, refused by the same frame policy; the card renders its text without the picture.
